name: Growlmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less. If no Digimon is deleted by this effect, trash the top 2 cards of both players' decks.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
